rows.text: Passenger [Trailblazer], ever since the start of this journey, there have been a lot of new visitors boarding the Express
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: These must be the rewards of the journey!
Yeah. You have to treasure these encounters!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: To savor these precious memories, the Express has left a guest book for all our new friends. They can write comments in it.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The guest book is on the bar counter. Go take a look when you have time
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
